title: Statutory Delay Interest Rate by Campus for Entrance Fee Agreement Refunds
content:
The campus rate of delay interest on an **Entrance Fee Agreement** refund follows the statute of the campus state: a refund outstanding past its due date at Larkspur at Brookfield carries 8.0 percent a year, one at Larkspur at Harbor View carries 9.0 percent a year, and a refund at any other campus carries no campus rate.

A refund is outstanding past its due date when it is paid on a day after the refund due date fixed on the agreement. The campus is the one named in the agreement.

## Rate table

| Campus | Refund paid after the due date | Refund paid on or before the due date |
|---|---|---|
| Larkspur at Brookfield | 8.0 percent a year | No campus rate |
| Larkspur at Harbor View | 9.0 percent a year | No campus rate |
| Larkspur at Willow Creek | No campus rate | No campus rate |

## Hypothetical cases

- Brookfield refund due 1 March and paid 2 March: 8.0 percent a year.
- Harbor View refund due 1 March and paid 1 March: no campus rate.
- Willow Creek refund paid 200 days after its due date: no campus rate.
